(Capacity: 12,508) |champion = |tourney = |tourney_result = }} {{2021–22 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Pittsburgh]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Panthers were led by fourth-year head coach [[Jeff Capel III|Jeff Capel]] and played their home games at the [[Petersen Events Center]] in [[Pittsburgh]], [[Pennsylvania]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Panthers finished the season 11–21 overall and 6–14 in [[2021–22 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a three way tie for eleventh place. As the twelfth seed in the [[2022 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they lost to thirteenth seed [[2021–22 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team|Boston College]] in the First Round. They were not invited to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] or the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Panthers]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 10–12, 6–10 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in 12th place. They lost to [[2020–21 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]] in the first round of the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {|
